title: Primitive Input, Timing, State & Goal Contract
objective: Define reusable primitive contracts for semantic input, deterministic logical timing, ephemeral local session state, counters/timers/targets/progress, success/failure, pause/retry, deterministic receipts and accessibility-equivalent controls without implementing traversal recipes, conflict patterns, NPC state machines, Aniloops or owner-domain rewards.

rules: Inputs are semantic MAL intents, not hard-coded keyboard/gamepad/touch bindings; device mappings and accessibility-equivalent bindings normalize to the same governed intent.

Timing uses deterministic logical ticks or explicitly authored integer durations/windows. Wall-clock timestamps, animation frame timing, network latency and device refresh rate are excluded from outcome truth and deterministic receipts.

MAL session state is ephemeral local interaction state only. Canonical Character, Action/Event, Project, World/Scene, Inventory, Combat, Travel, progression and Permission/visibility owners remain authoritative and are referenced rather than duplicated.

Goals may observe counters, authored targets, logical timers, progress values and reference collections. A reference-collection goal records MAL-local observation of canonical references and does not itself create an Inventory pickup or ownership transfer.

Succeeded/failed/cancelled are MAL-local session dispositions. They do not commit owner-domain consequences, rewards, damage, inventory, travel, project progress or Event outcomes; later authorized integration must explicitly map a MAL result reference into the owning domain.

Pause freezes MAL logical timing and state advancement without advancing campaign/world time. Retry creates a new deterministic attempt identity from the same authored definition and does not erase or mutate canonical owner history.

Deterministic receipts contain stable MAL definition/attempt IDs, normalized semantic inputs, logical tick progression, resulting local phase/goal/progress state, source/provenance references and canonical owner references; presentation text, wall-clock time, raw device identity and hidden unauthorized data are excluded.
Unknown, hidden or unauthorized owner state stays unresolved/filtered and never defaults to visible, successful or MAL-owned state.
AI may propose authored primitive definitions and bindings but cannot invent hidden inputs, approve outcomes, mutate owner truth or bypass accessibility/visibility rules.
forbidden: hard-coded device-only semantics as canonical input truth
